products.name: PING Social
products.tagline: AI concierge and business automation consultancy for home service businesses
products.summary: Practical automation consulting for independent home service businesses. We study how your business actually works, then recommend and implement the automation that fits: reliable inquiry capture, fast consistent response, follow-up that actually happens, review systems, and less administrative drag. Consultative, not packaged. Measurable value or the engagement does not continue.
offers: Workflow discovery: we learn your business before recommending anything
Reliable capture: every inquiry, job detail, and follow-up lands somewhere it cannot disappear
Response systems: acknowledgment in minutes, not days
Follow-up sequences: estimates, check-ins, and review requests that run without relying on memory
Review and reputation systems: happy customers asked at the right moment, problems surfaced early
notOffers: Systems you cannot understand or maintain

products.name: PING
products.tagline: Continuity infrastructure for AI agents and the businesses they serve
products.summary: The intelligence system underneath everything: event-sourced continuity, agent execution boundaries, evidence and provenance, deterministic replay. Real architecture, documented on this site as it is built. Not a product you can buy; the consultancy applies its principles to real businesses today.
documented: Continuity: events as source truth, knowledge that accumulates, evidence attached to claims
Agents: capability boundaries, stdin-based machine execution, reversible by default
Evidence: verification grades, contradiction preservation, typed failure semantics
Replay: deterministic ordering from the same causal history

products.name: Websites on TenantOS
products.tagline: One codebase, many tenants, configuration over forking
products.summary: The platform direction this site proves. TenantOS is the model where each tenant is configuration plus content plus brand plus domain, never a fork. This website is tenant one. Websites for other businesses on this model are future work, not an offering today.
products.proof: This site: identity, brand, navigation, and SEO resolve from a versioned tenant authority. Re-skinning is token changes, not code edits.
